context: This criteria evaluates the ability to build and append query string parameters to HTTP requests, including handling of objects, arrays, and different data types.

checklist.name: Basic query parameters
checklist.description: Correctly adds simple key-value pairs as query parameters using the query method

checklist.name: Complex data types
checklist.description: Properly handles arrays and boolean values in query parameters

checklist.name: Chainable queries
checklist.description: Demonstrates the ability to chain multiple query parameter additions that merge together
